description: default-tokenizers-reference.md lists 6 built-in tokenizers and default-token-filters-reference.md lists roughly 60 built-in token filters, but neither page states which one a Search index uses if none is explicitly configured. This contrasts with search-index-params.md, which explicitly states 'standard' as the default_analyzer and 'dateTimeOptional' as the default_datetime_parser - a stated default exists for the analyzer and the date/time parser, but no equivalent default_tokenizer (or default token filter) property or fallback is documented anywhere in this module for tokenizers or token filters specifically.
